title: wg: combiner-02 editorial fixes (32 items)
description:
Editorial findings in draft-ietf-mls-combiner (combiner-02). Editors' copy mlswg/mls-combiner at 380f0e1.

1. L89 (Introduction): The word 'the' is duplicated. Fix: "it addresses the harvest-now/decrypt-later threat model"
2. L111 (Terminology): RFC 5869 defines HKDF as an HMAC-based 'Extract-and-Expand' KDF, but this text reverses the order. 'Hashed Message Authentication Code' is also a nonstandard expansion. Fix: "An HMAC-based Extract-and-Expand Key Derivation Function (HKDF) as described in {{!RFC5869}}."
3. L147 (The Combiner Protocol Execution): The sentence is broken ('if an application that has ...'), and it compares a frequency with a time window. The following MUST ('the device MUST be considered inactive and removed') names no device and no actor. Read literally, it removes every member whenever the group goes too long without a FULL Commit. Fix: "...if an application has a threshold activity window for determining 'inactive' devices, the interval between FULL Commits MUST be shorter than that window. A member whose PQ leaf has not been updated within the window MUST be removed." Name who performs the removal, or make the rule non-normative.
4. L204 (Document-wide terminology): The term defined at line 120 is 'traditional' session, but lines 204 and 234 say 'classical session/proposal' and line 245 says 'standard session'. Fix: Use 'traditional session' at lines 204, 234 and 245.
5. L230 (Commit Flow (Fig 1b caption)): The word 'the' is duplicated. Fix: "Messages with ' are sent in the PQ session."
6. L246 (Adding a User): RFC 9420 has no 'PreSharedKeyID proposal'. The proposal is PreSharedKey, and PreSharedKeyID is the struct it carries, as lines 177 and 306 say. Line 245 also calls the traditional session the 'standard session'. Fix: "The same sequence is repeated in the traditional session, except following the FULL Commit combining sequence where a PreSharedKey proposal is additionally committed."
7. L286 (Welcome Message Validation): Fig 1b shows a FULL Commit to another member's Update proposal. A joiner's own FULL Commit with no pending proposals is the case shown in Fig 1a. Lines 247-249 state the joiner requirement differently ('as soon as possible', 'SHOULD be the first Commit'). Fix: Refer to Fig 1a, and state the joiner's FULL Commit requirement in one place.
8. L318 (External Joins): APQPublicMessage was removed by PR #26 and is no longer defined. The Wire formats section defines only APQMessagePair (`wire_format`, `t_message`, `pq_message`), carried with wire format `apq_message_pair`. Implementers cannot tell how external joins are framed. Fix: "...as a single APQMessagePair with `wire_format = mls_public_message` (see {{wire-formats}}), with the traditional session's Commit in `t_message`..."
9. L326 (Removing a Group Member): The word 'as' is duplicated. Fix: "...a FULL Commit Update as described in Fig 1b."
10. L352 (PQ/T Confidentiality Only): Misspelling. It is also present in -02. Fix: access
11. L387 (PQ/T Confidentiality + Authenticity): Misspelling. It is also present in -02. Fix: non-repudiation
12. L391 (PQ/T Confidentiality + Authenticity): The `!` makes this a normative reference, but it is cited only to point at options outside the draft's scope. A normative reference to an unfinished draft can also hold up publication. Fix: Use `{{?I-D.ietf-pquip-hybrid-signature-spectrums}}`.
13. L398 (Group Context Extension): 'APQInfo session' is the wrong term. The session is the APQ-MLS session. Fix: "...characterizing the APQ-MLS session..."
14. L402 (Group Context Extension): Misspelling. It is also present in -02. Fix: participating
15. L419 (Group Context Extension): `bool` is not a type in the TLS presentation language used by RFC 9420 or draft-ietf-mls-extensions-10, so the encoding of `mode` and the handling of values other than 0 and 1 are undefined. These bytes feed the GroupContext, so two decoders can disagree. The published -02 has the same problem. Fix: Declare it as `uint8 mode;` or as an enum such as `enum { confidentiality_only(0), confidentiality_and_authenticity(1), (255) } APQMode;`. Require recipients to reject any other value.
16. L424 (Group Context Extension): The TLS struct definition has no terminating semicolon. Fix: `} APQInfo;`
17. L451 (Updating APQInfo): The `select (update_type) {` block is opened but never closed, so the struct's braces are unbalanced and the definition does not parse. The enum also has inconsistent spacing (`full_update (0)` vs `new_t_epoch(1)`). Fix: Insert `    };` before `} APQInfoUpdate;`, and write `full_update(0)`.
18. L466 (Updating APQInfo): 'it's' should be 'its', and 'serialize' should be 'serialized'. Line 470 is missing a verb ('If instead AppDataUpdate proposal its `component_id` set'), and line 462 is missing an article ('one of following two methods'). Fix: "...then its `new_apq_info` field MUST contain a TLS-serialized instance..."; "If instead the AppDataUpdate proposal has its `component_id` set..."; "one of the following two methods".
19. L486 (Updating APQInfo): `new_pq_info` is not defined anywhere. The `full_update` arm of APQInfoUpdate names its field `new_apq_info`. Fix: Replace `new_pq_info` with `new_apq_info`.
20. L497 (Updating APQInfo): The sentence is garbled: 'epoch fields ... have cipher suites and epochs'. It is unclear which fields the normative check covers. Fix: "...recipients MUST verify that the APQInfo structs in the GroupContexts of both new epochs have cipher suite and epoch fields matching those of the two new epochs created by the FULL Commit."
21. L511 (Key Schedule): This calls the SafeExportSecret output `apq_psk`, but Figure 3 and line 580 call it `apq_exporter`, and `apq_psk` is derived from it later. The text conflates the exported secret with the PSK. Fix: "The `apq_exporter` secret derived in the PQ session MUST be derived in accordance with..."
22. L514 (Key Schedule): `extension_secret` is not defined in RFC 9420 or draft-ietf-mls-extensions-10. It is left over from an older extensions draft, and line 719 repeats it. Line 724 also says apq_psk is derived 'from the epoch_secret', which is looser than the SafeExportSecret rule. Fix: Say "it SHALL NOT use the RFC 9420 `exporter_secret` (MLS-Exporter) directly" and fix line 719 to match. At line 724, refer to SafeExportSecret (application_export_secret) rather than epoch_secret.
23. L527 (Key Schedule): The same requirement is written three ways: `PSKType = 3` (the type name, not the field) at line 527, and `psk_type = application` at lines 307 and 577. The field defined in RFC 9420 Section 8.4 and draft-ietf-mls-extensions-10 Section 4.5 is `psktype`. Fix: Write `psktype = application` at lines 307, 527 and 577.
24. L607 (Wire formats): The scope is not stated. Read alone, this forbids every PrivateMessage carrying application data, which contradicts Section Application Messages. The intended scope seems to be messages carried inside an APQMessagePair. Fix: "Messages carried in an APQMessagePair with wire format `mls_private_message` MUST NOT be of content type `application`."
25. L622 (Cipher Suites): 'a APQ-MLS' should be 'an APQ-MLS'. The same error appears at lines 161, 630 and 632. Fix: Change each to 'an APQ-MLS'.
26. L628 (Cipher Suites / Signing): Section 4 names the modes 'PQ/T Confidentiality Only' and 'PQ/T Confidentiality + Authenticity'. Lines 628-629, 648 and 654 use different names. Fix: Use the Section 4 mode names throughout.
27. L640 (Key Encapsulation Mechanism): A broken normative sentence ('is MUST be'). Fix: "...hybrid KEMs in the PQ session MUST be rejected by compliant clients."
28. L650 (Signing / Introduction): FIPS 204 is named but not cited, and ML-KEM/ML-DSA in the Introduction have no reference entries. Fix: Add FIPS203 and FIPS204 as informative references and cite them.
29. L692 (Attacks on Non-Repudiation): 'signatures on used' is broken, probably meaning 'are used'. Also, in MLS the signature is computed over content that is then AEAD-encrypted, not 'after the AEAD'. Fix: "...since only traditional signatures are used (inside the AEAD-protected content)."
30. L701 (Attacks on Non-Repudiation): 'for' is the wrong conjunction, which makes the sentence hard to parse. The intended contrast is 'but'. Fix: "...assured that a message was sent by a group member, but the adversary has changed the signature to imply a different sender;"
31. L744 (IANA Considerations / apq_mls_info MLS Component Type): Component ID 0x0006 is also used as a SafeExportSecret label and as the component_id of an application PSK (lines 176, 527, 577). The draft-ietf-mls-extensions-10 Section 7.5 template has the codes ES and PS for those uses, so listing only GC leaves the registration incomplete. Fix: `- Where: GC, ES, PS`
32. L759 (IANA Considerations / apq_psk MLS PSK label): A leftover TODO placeholder. No 'MLS PSK label' registry exists in RFC 9420 or draft-ietf-mls-extensions-10, because PSK labels are covered by the component registration (Where: PS). Fix: Delete the subsection, and cover the PSK use with `PS` in the 0x0006 registration.

From MLS audit workflow wf_581e61f8-b25 (2026-10-21), verified per item. Not yet reviewed by Mark; nothing posted upstream.
close_reason: 2026-10-21: sent as https://github.com/mlswg/mls-combiner/pull/34. 20 of 31 applied (one partly); skipped items touching #27/#29/#32/#33 and ones that change requirements, references, IANA or the mode encoding (editors' calls).
